response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM per_account) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_amount, p.n, CAST(p.n AS REAL) / o.avg_n AS ratio FROM per_account p CROSS JOIN overall o ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average is taken over the stored, unsigned `amount` values of all of an account's `trans` rows, with no sign applied by `trans.type`, as the request specifies.
The average number of transactions per account is the mean of per-account row counts over accounts that appear in `trans`, and the ratio uses real-valued division so no integer truncation occurs.
Ties at the 10th place are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT, as the request allows, and no rounding is applied.
The SQL is standard SQL (CTEs, CAST, CROSS JOIN) and should run on the SQLite schema shown; the dialect is not stated, so this is assumed.
